passages.context: Norms I–IV connect entry into the clerical state with the diaconate, rename the former minor orders ministries, permit ministries to be entrusted to lay faithful, and retain lector and acolyte as the two ministries observed throughout the Latin Church.
passages.notes: Exact official Latin web control; no inference is made from these norms to the distinct authorization governed by current canon 1172.

passages.context: The introduction identifies ostiariate, lectorate, exorcistate, and acolytate as grades formerly called minor orders; it then distinguishes the two ministries retained throughout the Latin Church from other ministries an episcopal conference may ask the Apostolic See to institute, giving porter, exorcist, and catechist as examples.
passages.notes: Exact official Latin web control. It does not establish that any conference request was made or approved, create a universal exorcist ministry, or authorize major exorcism.
